description_expanded: Overview5.0(39 reviews)INLET BEACH – Playa Maya Private Pool & Courtyards | Steps to Rosemary | Sleeps 10 DESCRIPTION Playa Maya is a beautifully designed, three-story luxury retreat in Inlet Beach just steps from Rosemary Beach. It is conveniently located within walking distance of the shops and restaurants of 30Avenue and Rosemary Beach. With 4 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, and over 3,000 sq ft of elegant living space, this home is perfect for families or groups seeking comfort, style, and proximity to the beach. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Enjoy rare and private outdoor spaces including a courtyard with a private pool, a private back patio for quiet dinners, and front balconies perfect for sunsets. It is a quick 4-minute walk to the sugary sands and emerald waters of the Gulf. HOME FEATURES 4 bedrooms | 4 full + 1 half bathrooms | Sleeps 10 Private pool (heating available for an additional fee) Two courtyards with lounge seating and dining areas Elevator for easy access across all levels Fully equipped kitchen and ice maker Smart TVs in every bedroom Fireplace and stylish, coastal furnishings Walk to 30Avenue and Rosemary Beach dining and shopping Optional carriage house with extra bed and living area (added fee, based on availability) Five adult bikes included DINING & ENTERTAINMENT Steps to local restaurants, coffee shops, and boutiques Close to all the fantastic restaurants in Inlet, Seacrest, Rosemary, and Alys Beach. Near Rosemary Beach Racquet Club and 30A bike trails WHY STAY HERE? Ideal for families and small groups Unique outdoor spaces for lounging and entertaining Walkable location with easy beach access SLEEPING ACCOMMODATIONS 3 King bedrooms Bedroom with two Queen beds Playa Maya is your upscale 30A getaway combining luxury, location, and laid-back beach vibes all in one.Show less
